english.title: Deliver pursuant to a delivery arrangement a bladed product to residential premises to a person under 18
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a body corporate, who had entered into an arrangement with a seller, namely **(..SPECIFY SELLER..), in accordance with section 39(1) of the Offensive Weapons Act 2019, delivered a bladed product, namely **(..SPECIFY BLADED PRODUCT..), otherwise than into the hands of a person age 18 years or over
english.legislation: Contrary to section 39(1), (6) and (7)(a) of the Offensive Weapons Act 2019.

english.notes:
(i) 'bladed product' is defined in section 41(1) as an article which is or has a blade or is capable of causing serious injury to a person which involves cutting that persons skin.(ii) 'bladed product' does not apply to flick knives, gravity knives or an order made by the Secretary of State under section 141(A)(3)(c) of the Criminal Justice Act 1988.
(iii) 'residential premises' means premises used solely for residential purposes and not where a person carries on a business from the premises as defined in section 39(4) and 39(5).
(iv) A defence is available at section 40(7) when a person takes all reasonable precautions and exercises due diligence.
(v) Please note the transitional requirement in regulation 3 of SI 2022/418 – stating this offence does not apply where the sale referred to in section 39(1)(a) of the Act takes place before 6th April 2022 and the person referred to in section 39(1)(e) of the Act has not delivered the bladed product by that date.
